About

Two countries, one direction.

Growing up across Morocco and the United Arab Emirates gave me a global perspective and the ability to adapt to different cultures and environments. Those years also fostered an interest in how businesses and financial markets connect people, industries and economies.

I am passionate about finance, investing and entrepreneurship, and I want to build a strong foundation in business administration while gaining the practical experience that lets me test new solutions to existing business problems. Jadeite, my activewear brand, is where that starts.
